name: track_then_log
title: First day · "track what I eat" gets a table at once, and "log two eggs" a row

steps.reply:
I've set up a Food log in a new Food module. Each entry has what you ate, when, which meal, the amount, calories, protein, carbs and fat. It also records where the numbers came from.

It's empty so far. Tell me what you eat in plain words, like "two boiled eggs and toast for breakfast". I'll log it and look up the nutrition where I can. When I have to estimate, such as a home-cooked portion, I'll label it as an estimate. You can also ask me for totals, like "how much protein did I have this week?".

I logged two eggs as a snack at 22:17: **143 kcal, 12.6 g protein, 0.7 g carbs, 9.5 g fat**.

- **Source:** the numbers are USDA values for a large egg (72 kcal each), doubled. I entered them from memory and didn't re-check the USDA page.
- **Assumptions:** I assumed large eggs, no oil or butter in the cooking, and "snack" because you didn't give a meal.

If they were a different size, or fried in butter or oil, tell me and I'll correct the entry.
